notes: RULES.json is authoritative for check ids, modules, stages, tier_min, introduced_in, status and bundles (SPEC 7.4, 7.5, 20.2).
status: enforced | advisory (FAIL/MISSING reported as WARN) | planned (registered but not implemented; excluded from every bundle; listed in README 'Not yet enforced').
warn_below_tier N: FAIL/MISSING are reported as WARN while the computed tier is below N.
applies_when: 'always...' means the check may never return NOT_APPLICABLE; any other text declares the condition under which NOT_APPLICABLE is allowed.
bundle entries: an id, {id, when}, or {group, when, primary[], fallback[]}; when is one of t2, sealed_confirm, sealed_or_adoption, oc_intended, udi_applicable.
bundles with kind 'command' list the checks a command runs; they are not gate stages.
